description: Enter your date of birth to get your exact age in years, months and days, plus total weeks, days, hours, the weekday you were born, and days until your next birthday.

faqs.a: Years, months and days are computed by comparing the birth date with the target date and borrowing days/months when needed, so the result matches how calendars actually work.
faqs.q: How is the exact age calculated?

faqs.a: Leap years add extra days. The total day count uses the real calendar difference between the two dates, including leap days.
faqs.q: Why does the total days count differ from years times 365?

faqs.a: Yes, change the 'as of' date field to any date and the age is recalculated relative to it.
faqs.q: Can I calculate age as of a past or future date?

howto: Pick your date of birth from the calendar picker.
Optionally change the 'as of' date, or leave it as today.
Your exact age is calculated instantly below.
See total months, weeks, days and hours, plus your birth weekday and countdown to your next birthday.
title: Age Calculator
